node.title: Re^5: One liner with globs on Windows to parse .srt files
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
nice, I didn't know that trick to add "normal" code after the import; part of use 5 =)

Note unfortunately it doesn't end up inside the BEGIN:

$ perl -MO=Deparse '-M5;print "Hello"' -e 'print "World"' sub BEGIN { require 5; () } print 'Hello'; print 'World';

The trick was added to [doc://perlsecret#Maori-farewell|perlsecret] as the "Maori Farewell" by [Discipulus] after I posted about it [id://1227366|here].
